description: SealedSecretSpec is the specification of a SealedSecret.

data.description: Data is deprecated and will be removed eventually. Use per-value EncryptedData instead.

fullNameOverride.description: Replaces the entire computed resource name, ignoring the release name and id.

nameOverride.description: Replaces just the id part of the computed resource name (<Release.Name>-<id>).

namespace.description: metadata.namespace for this resource. Defaults to the release namespace.

template.description:
Template defines the structure of the Secret that will be
created from this sealed secret.

data.description:
Keys that should be templated using decrypted data.
Set a key with the same name as in `encryptedData`
to `null` to omit the unsealed data from the final secret.

immutable.description:
Immutable, if set to true, ensures that data stored in the Secret cannot
be updated (only object metadata can be modified).
If not set to true, the field can be modified at any time.
Defaulted to nil.

type.description: Used to facilitate programmatic handling of secret data.
